Trap Space Unassuming in form, at only the size of a closed 
fist, the shriekshroom grows along damp walls looking like 
much of the other fungal growths. Only when within 5 ft. of it, 
and it feels the presence of a creature will it react.
Countering Often clustered with other mushrooms, the dark 
clam-like shape can easily be hidden amongst more vibrant 
growths. Wisdom (Perception) Check: DC 14. Success: The Natural 
Trap is identified.
With so many creatures evolved to feast on the plentiful 
mushrooms that spread along the darkened halls of the 
Umbrawells, the shriekshroom has adapted by reacting to 
nearby stimulus aggressively. Fibers pull back and crack open 
the hard clamped shell, releasing trapped carbon dioxide out 
of the gills in a high pitched whistle.
Senses Blindsight 5 ft. (Blind beyond this radius).
Immunities Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, 
Frightened, Prone

Trap Space Growing on stone walls within large vaulted caverns, 
when ready to propagate, the mushroom snaps open as it senses 
disturbances in the air, launching its hard spore cluster at 
anything that moves within a 20 ft. Sphere of it.
Countering When in bloom, the spore cluster can be seen open 
and ready to launch. Wisdom (Perception) Check: DC 10. Success: 
The Natural Trap is identified.

Trap Space Like a stalactite, the pilthcluster hangs from the 
ceiling and occupies a 5 ft. Square above, dripping when it 
senses heat in the space below it.
Trap Space Spreading across the ground in a carpet of white 
globules, this slime mold covers a 10 ft. Circle space.
Countermeasures Gray like the stone it grows from, the 
pilthcluster's form can be identified with a trained eye. Wisdom 
(Perception) Check: DC 12. Success: The Natural Trap is identified.
Countermeasures Nonthreatening in appearance and easily 
stepped upon, alzabrath can be missed without notice. Wisdom 
(Perception) Check: DC 11. Success: The Natural Trap is identified.
Many unfortunate creatures that felt its burn would disagree, 
but the pilthcluster bacterial growth is a key component 
of the subterranean ecology. Filtering out the highly acidic 
environment into rich bacterial matter that falls below it, while 
at first it is highly acrid, with time it settles into a soil-like 
substance that plants and fungus can use to take root.
When faced with drought, the alzabrath slime mold halts all 
growth and congeals into clusters of globules waiting to burst. 
As creatures traverse over the carpet, popping spore clouds 
collect on their body while they continue through the cramped 
corridors, unaware that the fog of spores had clouded their 
mind with forgetfulness, wandering about lost and spreading 
the spores.
In attempt to out compete the variaty of other fungus that 
flourish in the Umbrawells, the clammuster makes use of a 
condensed spore dart to fire its progeny far into the caverns.
Senses Blindsight 30 ft. (Blind beyond this radius).
